cohort: The study included 66 mother-child pairs at birth with full-term pregnancies (gestational weeks 37-42).
finding: Neonatal VDBP genotypes (rs2298850 and rs4588) in conjunction with specific neonatal 25(OH)D cutoffs were associated with neonatal upper arm length and upper thigh circumference, while no significant effect was found for maternal VDBP polymorphisms or 25(OH)D concentrations.
